# USRSE'26 — Program

> The complete program for USRSE'26 (US-RSE Conference 2026), the annual
> conference of the US Research Software Engineer Association (US-RSE), held
> October 19–21, 2026 in San Jose, California, USA. Theme: "Advancing Science
> in the Age of AI". 3 days, 45 sessions, 82 talks (80 with published
> abstracts). All times are US Pacific (UTC-07:00).

This file is generated from the conference schedule and changes only when the
schedule does. The program is not final and is subject to change — check the
program page for the authoritative current version.

## How to use this file

- Every session carries both a wall-clock time and an ISO 8601 range. Prefer
  the ISO range for anything you compute.
- Sessions are listed in chronological order within each day, and each one
  lists the sessions it runs against under "Concurrent with" — that is the
  choice to resolve when picking between parallel tracks.
- Breaks, meals and registration are listed too. They are not filler: they are
  the gaps an attendee schedule is built around.
- Talk titles link to that talk's entry on its abstract page.
- Abstract text is not in this file. For the same schedule with every
  published abstract inlined, fetch:
  https://us-rse.org/usrse26/program/llms-full.txt

Human-readable program page: https://us-rse.org/usrse26/program/
